slug: 2025-06-18 Burundi's Land Services Go Digital with New Integrated Platform

systems.system: Electronic Document and Records Management System (EDRMS)
systems.owner: Directorate of Land Titles and National Cadastre (DTFCN); World Bank funded under PAFEN
systems.tiers: internal tool of the directorate, launched 17 June 2025; integrated with the Building Permit System and the Property Management System

note: A land administration system, out of scope; nothing on civil registration.
